items.titleZh: Anthropic 提出人工智能安全法案，如果 50 多人死亡，该法案可能会阻止模型的发展
items.titleEn: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
items.summaryZh: TechCrunch AI 报告了人工智能的政策发展。消息来源的关键点：拟议的政策似乎提供了针对人工智能失控的保护措施，但实际上禁止联邦机构在未经法官许可的情况下阻止模型的发布。
items.summaryEn: TechCrunch AI reports a policy development in AI. Key point from the source: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.
items.overviewZh: TechCrunch AI 发布了关于“Anthropic 提出的 AI 安全法案，如果可能导致 50 人以上死亡，该法案可能会阻止模型”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: TechCrunch AI published a new update about “Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed”.
